sweep.source_phase_ownership: Read every Quick Sweep input DCPH, independently of ordinary source phase.

primary_power_axis: Quick Sweep DCP output W; ordinary DCP and raw spectral V/Z/P are scored separately.

hypotheses.name: native_analytic
hypotheses.origin: Existing C++ documented amplitude cubic with exact dB-peak normalization.

hypotheses.name: rounded_shift_only
hypotheses.origin: Hypothesis: use 2.5 dB instead of exact 20*log10(4/3). Not documented vendor implementation.

hypotheses.name: rounded_shift_frozen_scale
hypotheses.origin: Same rounded-shift hypothesis with scale frozen from earlier retrospective fit; new runs are transfer tests, not a derivation of a vendor constant.

hypotheses.name: frozen_retrospective_mapping
hypotheses.origin: Both parameters frozen from earlier 37-point fit. No refitting or tolerance changes during this study.

rules: Save all points, including zero-dBm and clamp-region disagreements.
Validate runtime parameter SI values, source power/phase, sweep shape, node identities, frequency and dataset freshness.
Stop on unexpected warnings/errors, incomplete analysis or timeout; no blind rerun or application kill.
Restore every modified expression and sweep flag; do not save changed workspace or recompute after restoration.
No kernel formula changes are authorized by a fit alone; assess held-out transfer and source semantics first.
